desc:
Requirements: complete The War Within, reach Mastery Rank 5. The final showdown also needs a Railjack with Intrinsics rank 5.

Run any regular level 20+ Grineer mission (Capture on Cassini, Saturn is the classic spot, solo recommended). It does not work in Sorties, Fissures, Invasions, Quests, or Dark Sectors. When a Larvling is eligible, the lights flicker yellow — kill enemies quickly and a Kuva Larvling spawns, marked on your HUD.

Get the Larvling to low health and it kneels. A weapon icon hovers above its head — THAT is the weapon your Lich will carry. Don't like it? Extract and try again; the weapon only locks in when you mercy-kill. The Warframe you use for the mercy kill is the Progenitor and sets the weapon's bonus element, so plan your frame before you stab.
farm: Cassini, Saturn (Capture) — fast, solo, level 20+ Grineer.
name: Spawning a Kuva Lich
short: Requirements, the Larvling hunt on Saturn, and how the mercy kill creates your nemesis.

desc:
Requirements: complete The War Within AND Call of the Tempestarii, Mastery Rank 5.

First get a Zenith Granum Crown: kill a Treasurer (the special Corpus unit that spawns in Corpus missions) and pick it up. Then load into a Corpus ship tileset mission, find the glowing golden hand terminal, and use the Crown to enter the Granum Void.

Inside you must kill 75 enemies before the timer runs out — this is the skill check, so bring a strong loadout. A Candidate then appears. Down her and mercy-kill her to create your Sister. Like Liches, she shows her weapon first, and the Warframe you mercy-kill with is the Progenitor that sets the Tenet weapon's bonus element.
farm: Any Corpus ship mission for Treasurers; Granum Void via the golden hand terminal.
name: Spawning a Sister of Parvos
short: Zenith Granum Crown, Granum Void, and the 75-kill Candidate spawn.

desc:
Your Lich/Sister is protected by a hidden sequence of 3 Requiem mods in a specific order. You learn the sequence through Requiem Murmurs.

Run missions on planets your nemesis controls (marked in red). Special red-marked Thralls (Liches) or Hounds (Sisters) spawn — mercy-kill them for murmurs. Enough murmurs reveal which 3 mods are in the sequence, but NOT their order.

Equip your 3 guesses on the Parazon (Arsenal → Parazon → Requiem tab). When your nemesis spawns in a controlled mission, down it and use the Parazon stab: the game tests your sequence top to bottom. Correct mods stick and stay revealed; the first wrong one breaks the attempt, downing you. A failed stab gives bonus murmurs and the nemesis ranks up — so each attempt gives you real information. It's a logic puzzle: with 3 known mods there are only 6 possible orders, and every failed attempt eliminates possibilities.
farm: Run your nemesis's controlled missions in public squads — everyone's thralls feed everyone's murmur progress.
name: Requiem Murmurs & the Sequence
short: How thralls reveal the 3 mods, and the guess-and-test logic for the order.

desc:
Nemeses have 5 levels. Every failed Parazon attempt ranks them up: they get stronger, their controlled territory spreads to more planets, and the tax they steal from your mission rewards grows (they can steal anything, including prime parts). Kill thralls and convert other players' nemeses to keep them in check, and don't let a Lich sit at rank 5 stealing from you forever.

Once all 3 Requiem mods land in the right order, the final confrontation unlocks: a Railjack mission — Saturn Proxima for Kuva Liches, Neptune Proxima for Sisters. Board their capital ship, down them, and make the choice: Vanquish or Convert.
farm: Finale: Railjack Skirmish at Saturn Proxima (Lich, Intrinsics 5) or Neptune Proxima (Sister, Intrinsics 3).
name: Lich Levels & the Final Stab
short: Ranks 1–5, stolen loot tax, territory growth, and the Railjack finale.

desc:
VANQUISH: kill them. You get their Kuva/Tenet weapon (delivered to your Foundry, bypassing the listed Mastery Rank requirement) plus their Ephemera if they had one. This is the weapon-farming choice.

CONVERT: spare them. They become a Railjack crewmate / mission ally that occasionally drops into your missions to fight beside you. You do NOT get the weapon this time — but a converted nemesis's contract becomes tradable to other players, and converted Liches/Sisters with rare Ephemeras or high bonus percentages sell well. Convert the ones with Ephemeras you want to trade; vanquish the weapons you want to keep.
farm: Converted nemesis contracts are traded in Maroo's Bazaar or the clan dojo.
name: Vanquish vs Convert
short: Take the weapon, or spare them for an ally and a tradable contract.

desc:
Every Kuva/Tenet weapon rolls a bonus element at 25–60% strength. Got the weapon you love at 27% Toxin? Spawn another of the same weapon, then fuse the duplicate into your good one in the Orbiter (Arsenal → weapon → Valence Fusion).

Fusion keeps the higher bonus and adds a chunk of the donor's on top, pushing toward the 60% hard cap. It takes a few duplicates to max a weapon, but a 60% bonus is a massive damage multiplier — roughly equivalent to a free elemental mod. Always fuse INTO the weapon with the element you want; the element of the kept weapon wins.
farm: Duplicates come from spawning and vanquishing more Liches/Sisters with the same weapon.
name: Valence Fusion
short: Fuse duplicates to raise the bonus element toward the 60% cap.

desc:
Every Lich/Sister has a 20% chance to spawn wearing a Vengeful Ephemera that matches its progenitor element (Vengeful Toxin, Vengeful Heat, etc.). You can see it on the Larvling/Candidate preview screen — if the Ephemera is what you're after, that's the one to hunt regardless of weapon.

You keep the Ephemera whether you Vanquish or Convert, and Ephemera-carrying converted nemeses are the most valuable trades in the system.
farm: Check the preview on every Larvling/Candidate before you commit.
name: Vengeful Ephemeras
short: The 20% cosmetic jackpot — element-matched, kept whether you vanquish or convert.

desc:
One of the 8 farmable Requiem mods. Each has 3 charges — one charge is consumed only when you successfully vanquish/convert a nemesis with it in the sequence. Failed stabs never consume charges.

Crack Requiem I relics in Kuva Fortress Void fissures (the uncommon/silver reward). Requiem relics drop from Kuva Siphons, are guaranteed from Kuva Floods, and occasionally from Thralls/Hounds.
farm: Requiem I relics → Kuva Fortress fissures.
name: Lohk
short: Requiem mod from Requiem I relics. 3 charges; consumed only on a successful kill.

desc:
The 9th Requiem mod and the system's best shortcut: Oull counts as WHATEVER mod the current slot needs. Dropped at a low chance from a nemesis that flees after a successful Parazon stab.

You can only equip one Oull at a time. Smart use: slot Oull in an unrevealed position to skip murmur-farming that slot, or use it to test a position without spending murmur knowledge. It still consumes a charge on a successful kill like any Requiem mod.
farm: Chance drop from a nemesis that survives a successful Parazon stab.
name: Oull
short: Wildcard 9th Requiem — counts as any mod in the sequence. Only one equipped at a time.

desc: Mercy-kill the Larvling/Candidate with one of these Warframes to give the weapon an Impact bonus. The most common picks are Rhino, Wukong, and Grendel.
frames: Baruuk, Dante, Gauss, Grendel, Rhino, Sevagoth, Wukong, Zephyr
name: Impact Progenitors
short: Baruuk, Dante, Gauss, Grendel, Rhino, Sevagoth, Wukong, Zephyr.

desc: Mercy-kill with one of these for a Heat bonus. Ember and Nezha are the easy picks; Heat pairs beautifully with Viral builds for armor-stripping.
frames: Chroma, Ember, Inaros, Jade, Kullervo, Nezha, Protea, Temple, Uriel, Vauban, Wisp
name: Heat Progenitors
short: Chroma, Ember, Inaros, Jade, Kullervo, Nezha, Protea, Temple, Uriel, Vauban, Wisp.

desc: Mercy-kill with one of these for a Cold bonus. Frost and Titania are the common picks. Cold builds into Viral with Toxin and is the natural fit for weapons with innate Toxin.
frames: Frost, Gara, Hildryn, Koumei, Revenant, Styanax, Titania, Trinity
name: Cold Progenitors
short: Frost, Gara, Hildryn, Koumei, Revenant, Styanax, Titania, Trinity.

desc: Mercy-kill with one of these for an Electricity bonus. Excalibur and Volt are the easy picks.
frames: Banshee, Caliban, Excalibur, Gyre, Limbo, Nova, Valkyr, Volt
name: Electricity Progenitors
short: Banshee, Caliban, Excalibur, Gyre, Limbo, Nova, Valkyr, Volt.

desc: The meta pick for most Kuva/Tenet weapons. Toxin builds into Viral (with Cold) or Corrosive (with Electricity), the two most-used damage combos in the game — that's why a high Toxin bonus is the default recommendation. Saryn is the go-to progenitor frame; Nidus and Ivara work too.
frames: Atlas, Dagath, Ivara, Khora, Nekros, Nidus, Oberon, Oraxia, Saryn
name: Toxin Progenitors
short: Atlas, Dagath, Ivara, Khora, Nekros, Nidus, Oberon, Oraxia, Saryn. The meta default.

desc: Mercy-kill with one of these for a Magnetic bonus. Niche — mostly for weapons where you specifically want Magnetic, like the Kuva Hek or Tenet Tetra.
frames: Citrine, Cyte-09, Harrow, Hydroid, Lavos, Mag, Mesa, Xaku, Yareli
name: Magnetic Progenitors
short: Citrine, Cyte-09, Harrow, Hydroid, Lavos, Mag, Mesa, Xaku, Yareli.

desc: Mercy-kill with one of these for a Radiation bonus. Ash and Loki are the common picks.
frames: Ash, Equinox, Garuda, Loki, Mirage, Nyx, Octavia, Qorvex, Voruna
name: Radiation Progenitors
short: Ash, Equinox, Garuda, Loki, Mirage, Nyx, Octavia, Qorvex, Voruna.

desc:
A cannon that fires a devastating cannonball (alt-fire: long-range flak barrage). Drastically stronger than the base Zarr, and one of the few primaries that stays relevant at level cap with a good build.

Build it for crit + Viral/Heat and watch rooms disappear. Toxin progenitor is the standard (builds into Viral easily); Heat is the alternative for a heat-stacking setup. S-tier and worth your first Lich if it shows up.
farm: Vanquish a Kuva Lich carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Kuva Zarr
short: S-tier cannon. One of the strongest primaries in the game.

desc:
Explosive arrows with cluster bombs that can be detonated mid-flight. The poster child of Kuva weapons — absurd area damage and still a Steel Path staple.

Toxin progenitor is the standard pick (build Viral/Heat on top). If a Bramma shows on your Larvling, take it — you will use it for years.
farm: Vanquish a Kuva Lich carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Kuva Bramma
short: S-tier explosive bow. Absurd AoE, Steel Path staple.

desc:
A beam secondary that chains between enemies, with one of the highest crit multipliers in the game and huge status chance. It has innate Radiation, so a Toxin progenitor lets you stack Viral trivially.

It's the best primer in the game: paint a whole room with status in one trigger pull, then swap to your real killer. Every serious loadout wants one. Runs on Saryn-progenitor Toxin.
farm: Vanquish a Kuva Lich carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Kuva Nukor
short: S-tier primer. Chains status to whole rooms; best status applicator in the game.

desc:
The Hek's bigger, meaner brother: alt-fire dumps all four barrels at once for a shotgun blast that deletes single targets. Niche-meta for bossing and one-shot builds.

Toxin for general use; Magnetic progenitor is a known niche pick for anti-Corpus setups.
farm: Vanquish a Kuva Lich carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Kuva Hek
short: A-tier quad-barrel shotgun. Boss killer and one-shot build staple.

desc:
A precision rifle with a 50% headshot damage bonus baked in. Slow, deliberate, and devastating — the sniper-player's Kuva weapon. Outclasses most rifles on single-target DPS when you hit heads.

Heat or Toxin progenitor depending on your faction focus.
farm: Vanquish a Kuva Lich carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Kuva Chakkhurr
short: A-tier precision rifle with a huge headshot bonus.

desc:
Fires semi-automatically instead of the base Ogris's awkward charge trigger, with much higher damage in a smaller magazine. A rocket launcher that actually feels good to use.

Toxin progenitor; build Viral/Heat and mod for the big booms. Mind the self-damage/stagger without Cautious Shot.
farm: Vanquish a Kuva Lich carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Kuva Ogris
short: A-tier rocket launcher. Semi-auto, high damage, feels great.

desc:
No arming distance and wall penetration on a grenade launcher — fire it at your own feet and laugh. Higher crit, status, and base damage than the base Tonkor make it a legit room-clearer.

Toxin progenitor is standard. Bring Cautious Shot or be ready to stagger yourself.
farm: Vanquish a Kuva Lich carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Kuva Tonkor
short: A-tier grenade launcher. No arming distance, fires through walls.

desc: Hip-fire goes full-auto; aiming fires a 4-round burst. A quirky, satisfying assault rifle with real damage behind it. Not the flashiest Kuva weapon, but a solid all-rounder worth grabbing.
farm: Vanquish a Kuva Lich carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Kuva Quartakk
short: A-tier assault rifle with dual firing modes. Solid all-rounder.

desc:
The Sobek's Kuva upgrade: shorter reload, higher crit and status, more base damage, longer falloff range. A workhorse auto-shotgun that quietly competes with the Hek for the 'best Kuva shotgun' slot on sustained DPS.

Toxin progenitor, build Viral/Heat.
farm: Vanquish a Kuva Lich carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Kuva Sobek
short: A-tier auto shotgun. The sustained-DPS answer to the Hek.

desc: A pellet-hose shotgun with a big magazine — hold the trigger and melt. Falls just short of the Hek/Sobek on single-target, but unmatched for spraying status across crowds.
farm: Vanquish a Kuva Lich carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Kuva Kohm
short: B-tier pellet hose. Crowd-melting sustained fire.

desc: Improved stats across the board plus an extra full-auto firing mode. A fine rifle, outclassed by the Quartakk and Chakkhurr but perfectly serviceable — grab it for Mastery and keep it if you like the feel.
farm: Vanquish a Kuva Lich carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Kuva Hind
short: B-tier rifle with an extra auto mode. Solid, not spectacular.

desc: The arch-gun Kuva variant: explosive rounds, huge damage, and the best archwing/necramech weapon you can get from the Lich system. If you do Profit-Taker, Orphix, or archwing content, this is worth a dedicated Lich.
farm: Vanquish a Kuva Lich carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Kuva Ayanga
short: A-tier arch-gun. Best Lich-system option for archwing/necramech.

desc: Higher fire rate, bigger magazine, faster reload, and punch-through on a pocket shotgun. Short range and hungry ammo economy, but brutal up close.
farm: Vanquish a Kuva Lich carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Kuva Brakk
short: A-tier pocket shotgun. Brutal at close range.

desc: Big single shots with an explosion on impact and a crit focus. A fun, punchy sidearm — also obtainable from the Zealoid Prelate, so check that farm before spending a Lich on it.
farm: Vanquish a Kuva Lich carrying it, or farm the Zealoid Prelate. Bonus rolls 25–60%.
name: Kuva Seer
short: B-tier explosive pistol. Fun crit sidearm; also drops from the Zealoid Prelate.

desc:
Fires a wide plasma wave that ricochets off surfaces — point it at a doorway and clear the room behind it. Innate Radiation. One of the best shotguns in the game and the first Tenet weapon most players chase.

Toxin progenitor is standard (build Viral/Heat on top); Heat is the alternative. A genuine S-tier primary.
farm: Vanquish a Sister of Parvos carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Tenet Arca Plasmor
short: S-tier plasma shotgun. Room-clearing waves, top primary pick.

desc:
A guided missile launcher with innate Cold — pair it with a Toxin progenitor and you get Viral for free. Aim-guided rockets with huge AoE make it one of the most fun and effective Tenet primaries.

Toxin is the clear pick here thanks to the innate Cold.
farm: Vanquish a Sister of Parvos carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Tenet Envoy
short: A-tier guided rockets. Innate Cold + Toxin progenitor = free Viral.

desc:
A heavy scythe with an energy disc projectile on heavy attacks. One of the best melee weapons in the game — huge range, huge damage, and the disc gives it pseudo-ranged clear.

Bought from Ergo Glast in any relay for Corrupted Holokeys (earned from Railjack Void fissures), NOT from Sisters — the element is shown before you pay, so pick the best roll. Heat or Toxin.
farm: Ergo Glast (relay) for Corrupted Holokeys. Element shown before purchase.
name: Tenet Grigori
short: S-tier heavy scythe with a ranged energy disc. Buy from Ergo Glast.

desc:
A beam pistol with infinite ammo that regenerates — the secondary-slot answer to the Kuva Nukor. Not quite the primer the Nukor is, but an excellent beam sidearm for any loadout.

Heat or Toxin progenitor.
farm: Vanquish a Sister of Parvos carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Tenet Cycron
short: A-tier beam pistol with regenerating ammo. Great Nukor alternative.

desc:
Dual auto-pistols that lock onto multiple targets at once — hold the trigger and it shreds everything in front of you. One of the most satisfying secondaries in the game.

Heat or Toxin progenitor.
farm: Vanquish a Sister of Parvos carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Tenet Diplos
short: A-tier lock-on dual pistols. Shreds everything in front of you.

desc: A rapid-fire SMG with a unique pulsing alt-fire. Solid, accurate, and fun — not top of the Tenet pile, but a great all-round secondary worth grabbing for Mastery and then some.
farm: Vanquish a Sister of Parvos carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Tenet Spirex
short: B-tier SMG with a pulsing alt-fire. Solid all-rounder.

desc:
A rifle with a grenade alt-fire that dumps the whole magazine — the emptier the mag, the bigger the boom. Quirky and fun; reward timing your reloads.

Toxin for general use; Magnetic progenitor is the niche anti-Corpus pick.
farm: Vanquish a Sister of Parvos carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Tenet Tetra
short: B-tier rifle with a magazine-dump grenade alt-fire.

desc: A pocket shotgun pistol with a tight spread and real punch. Short range, big damage — the Detron you always wanted the base version to be.
farm: Vanquish a Sister of Parvos carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Tenet Detron
short: B-tier pocket shotgun. Huge close-range punch.

desc: A slow-firing, hard-hitting slug pistol — the hand-cannon of the Tenet set. One-taps most things with a good crit build. Niche-meta for secondary one-shot setups.
farm: Vanquish a Sister of Parvos carrying it. Bonus rolls 25–60%; Valence Fusion toward 60%.
name: Tenet Plinx
short: B-tier hand cannon. Slow, deliberate, huge crits.

desc:
A rifle that tethers enemies together, sharing damage between them — one of the most unique utility weapons in the game. The damage isn't chart-topping, but the tether mechanic enables wild combos.

Bought from Ergo Glast for Corrupted Holokeys.
farm: Ergo Glast (relay) for Corrupted Holokeys. Element shown before purchase.
name: Tenet Ferrox
short: B-tier utility rifle. Tethers enemies and shares damage.

desc:
A heavy blade with strong stats and a satisfying moveset. Outclassed by the Grigori but a fine heavy melee in its own right.

Bought from Ergo Glast for Corrupted Holokeys — element shown before you pay.
farm: Ergo Glast (relay) for Corrupted Holokeys. Element shown before purchase.
name: Tenet Exec
short: B-tier heavy blade. Solid, outclassed by the Grigori.

desc:
A rapier with fast, elegant combos and strong crit. A great pick if you like fast melee playstyles.

Bought from Ergo Glast for Corrupted Holokeys — element shown before you pay.
farm: Ergo Glast (relay) for Corrupted Holokeys. Element shown before purchase.
name: Tenet Livia
short: B-tier rapier. Fast, crit-focused, elegant.

desc:
A sword-and-shield combo with strong defensive utility. The shield throw gives it surprising range for a melee weapon.

Bought from Ergo Glast for Corrupted Holokeys — element shown before you pay.
farm: Ergo Glast (relay) for Corrupted Holokeys. Element shown before purchase.
name: Tenet Agendus
short: B-tier sword and shield. Defensive with a ranged shield throw.
